title: 5.4.8 Lab — Mutate this.sprite.x from a method
description: Write `Mover.moveRight(dx)` which adds `dx` to `this.sprite.x`, reaching through composition to move the wrapped sprite.

steps.title: Write the moveRight(dx) method
steps.instructions: Inside the `Mover` class body, write a `moveRight(dx)` method that adds `dx` to `this.sprite.x`. Hold the right arrow to see the sprite slide across the canvas.
hints: Open the shplay docs drawer on the right and find the Sprite properties section — look for how to read and write a sprite's position.

requirements.title: moveRight(dx) mutates this.sprite.x
requirements.description: Write a `moveRight(dx)` method that adds `dx` to `this.sprite.x` using `+=`.
